description: Refactor step M12c, class A (docs/plans/codebase-refactor.md §6.5): internal/domain/users's users.go splits by concern. users.go keeps the account: the auth providers, the errors, User, Repository, Service, DefaultService and its constructor, NormalizeEmail, Register, and the account's reads and settings (GetByID, FindByEmail, ListUsers, SetAdmin, the notification, default-workspace and trial flags, the avatar). Session, the session policy's setter and reader, the sign-ins (Login, LoginWithGoogle, LoginWithSSO), createSession, Logout, sessionLive, lastSeen, GetBySessionToken, SessionByToken and SetActiveOrg go to session.go, beside session_policy.go; EmailVerificationTTL, EmailVerificationPolicy, EmailVerification, SetEmailVerificationPolicy, IssueEmailVerification, ConfirmEmailVerification and MarkEmailVerified to verification.go; MinPasswordLength, the reset link's constants, ErrResetInvalid, PasswordReset, IssuePasswordReset, ResetPassword and ChangePassword to password.go; HashToken and NewToken to token.go. users.go has no free-floating comment, so nothing is deleted from it. Preview with: go run ./internal/tools/declmove -n -spec internal/tools/declmove/specs/M12c-users.json

targets.header:
// Passwords: the length rule, a change by the account's owner, and the
